As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed. This task tests the agent's ability to explore and identify a specific block type in the environment.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate to within proximity of the farmland patch (centered at spawn-relative [6, -1, 4]) and be facing toward it. The farmland is ~7 blocks diagonally from spawn, so max_distance=8 ensures the player has actively navigated toward the farm rather than triggering from spawn. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the farmland (has 'found' it visually).

scene_description: A small farm area located ~5-7 blocks from spawn, featuring farmland blocks with crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes), a water irrigation channel, oak fence enclosure, a farmer villager, and some decorative hay bales and a composter nearby. The player spawns on a grass plain and must navigate to the farm to find the farmland blocks.
task_text: Find the farmland blocks in the nearby farm area.
design_notes: Farmland is placed at ~5-7 x, ~-1 y, ~3-5 z relative to spawn (about 7 blocks away diagonally). The farm has a 3x3 farmland patch with crops, water irrigation on one side, partial fence enclosure, and a farmer villager for visual context. Hay bales and composter are placed in the opposite direction as subtle environmental details. The agent must turn and walk roughly east-southeast to find the farm. The farmland is at y=-1 (ground level) which is standard. Water is within 4 horizontal blocks ensuring farmland stays hydrated.
